old: Confirm it and explain the reasons.
new: Explain the cost risks and current estimates.

old: Our spectrometer team built an instrument with no spacecraft to fly on. Carry it on your orbiter and we'll share every byte. Our ministry will contribute to costs.

old: My students built a 3 kg microphone to record the Martian wind. They have been sleeping in the lab for months. Will your lander carry it?

old: Say yes: the microphone rides in the lander's spare-mass margin.
new: Back the student project through the mission outreach programme.

old: The students cry on camera. The lander engineers find 3 kg of margin, mostly by staring at it.
new: The students present their microphone with the mission team. Partner and public trust rise; the flight payload is unchanged.

old: Duarte accepts your explanation with the warmth of a tax form. Feld sends a fruit basket.
